catalog.description: Manage your {products}: prices, photos, stock and attributes. Your AI agents use them to answer and send photos.
catalog.readOnly: Read-only: workspace admins can edit the catalog.
catalog.moduleOff: The “{module}” module is off for this business. Turn it on in Business setup → Industry.
catalog.emptyDescription: Add your {products} with a photo and price so the AI can recommend them and send them in chat.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU or attribute…
catalog.deleteDescription: Its variants and photos will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.

field.name: Name
field.currencyHint: Change it only if it is priced in another currency (e.g. a sale in US$). Orders and the cart use the business currency.
field.compareAtPriceHint: Shown struck through when higher than the price.
field.activeHint: Visible to the AI and your customers.

editor.description: The AI uses this data to recommend and answer about this {item}.

attrError.option: Pick an option from the list.

error.price: Enter a valid price (0 or more), or turn on “price on request”.
error.stock: Stock must be a whole number (0 or more).
error.variants: Every variant needs a name, and a valid price and stock.
error.skuTaken: Another item already uses that SKU.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

images.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 8 MB. The first photo is the cover and the one the AI sends.
images.uploadFailed: A photo could not be uploaded: {reason}

variants.title: Variants
variants.hint: Sizes, colors, portions… Each variant can have its own SKU, price and stock.
variants.name: Name

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Organize your {products}. Changes are saved right away.
categories.deleteDescription: Its {count} {products} will become uncategorized (they are not deleted).
categories.duplicate: A category with that name already exists.

attributes.title: Product attributes
attributes.description: Fields that describe your {products} (brand, bedrooms, allergens…). The AI uses them to search and filter. Changes are saved right away.
attributes.keyHint: Generated from the name: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
attributes.filterableHint: Customers and the AI can filter by this field.
attributes.deleteDescription: Values already saved on your {products} will no longer be shown.

error.label: Name is required.
error.key: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
error.keyPreset: An industry attribute already uses that key.
error.keyTaken: An attribute with that key already exists.
